newsitem.title: USA: Colder weather no threat for Brazil coffee - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Colder weather no threat for Brazil coffee - WSC.

text.p: A storm system is expected to intensify off the south coast of Brazil this coming weekend, however there is no sign of a threat to the coffee crop, Weather Services Corp said in an update on Monday.
According to WSC, The storm system should allow colder air to flow into the coffee belt but would provide no damaging cold.
Weather conditions this morning were mostly fair with partly cloudy skies and below normal temperatures. Lows ranged from the 40's to low 50's F (5-12 C).

Mostly fair skies are expected for the remainder of today in the coffee belt. Increasing clouds will develop on Tuesday and scattered showers are predicted for Wednesday. Temperatures will remain near to below normal with low temperatures in the middle 40's to middle 50's F (6-13 C).
WSC is expecting fair skies to arrive late in the week.
